checks.name: 2018 lists reconcile
checks.detail: 8,764 designated = 8,566 LIC + 198 contiguous, matching the 8,764 on CDFI's final list (reference).

checks.name: Crosswalk conserves the 2020 Census
checks.detail: 334,735,155 people allocated to 2010 tracts, equal to the 2020 Census count of 334,735,155 (US + PR, reference).

checks.name: 2020-24 ACS population survives conversion to 2010 tracts
checks.detail: 338,071,412 after conversion vs 338,079,229 in the pulled tracts (0.002% apart).

checks.name: Every populated 2020 tract is in the 2020-24 ACS
checks.detail: 14 populated 2020 tracts (76,505 people, county 36103) are not published in the 2020-24 ACS; their outcomes are null. For Suffolk County, NY (36103) these tracts appear in the 2017-21 and 2018-22 releases and disappear from 2019-23 on. List: data/oz1/acs2024_missing_tracts.csv.

checks.name: Tract geography maps plausibly
checks.detail: 272 of 73,053 tracts (0.37%) more than doubled or halved between the 2012-16 ACS and the 2020 Census; a mis-mapped tract would show up here, as do real booms and busts.

checks.name: Reproduces the Urban Institute's published tract means
checks.detail: On Urban's own universe and the same 2012-16 ACS, 5 of 6 measures match its published designated and control means (within 1% for dollars, 0.2 pp for rates). See the table for the ones that do not.

checks.name: Inflation adjustment
checks.detail: CPI-U 2016-to-2024 factor 1.307, from BLS annual averages 240.007 and 313.689 (reference).
